meta_description: Vision quality gates on four weld lines — escape rate down 61% and manual re-inspection stations retired at two plants

blocks.x: Vision quality gates on four weld lines, escape rate down 61% and manual re-inspection stations retired at two plants
Identity withheld, an automotive tier-1 whose weld quality lived between sampled audits and the customer's next complaint. Figures are the client's own, shared with permission.

The baseline quarter costed the sampling: 100% inspection on only the highest-risk line, 3.1% escape rate reaching the customer on the others, and containment events that cost more than the inspection equipment they argued about.
Camera hardware existed on two lines but nobody trusted it: thresholds drifted with lighting, false rejects annoyed operators into bypass, and the bypass had no audit trail.

We rebuilt the gates as trusted vision: defect signatures learned per joint type with process engineers labeling ground truth, illumination normalization making thresholds stable across shifts, bypass made impossible without an engineer's logged authorization, and the quality twin tracking every weld's disposition to the vehicle. Containment became a query, not a crisis.
